notes: Complete Robert Towns Monument described and photographed in the Castle Hill story: own two octagonal stepped plinths, square chamfered white tablet pedestal and moulded base, four steep Gothic gables with trefoil relief and scroll shoulders, segmented tapered octagonal shaft with medallion/toothed bands and foliate broken capital. Exclude the natural hill, whole lookout, road/parking, unrelated shelters/rails, vegetation, people, inscription text and interior.
